subject: Choosing the right number of cofactors

messages.subject: Choosing the right number of cofactors
parts:
What is the criteria to setting the right number of marker cofactors for our mqm models? 

This comes up when I am using the mqmautocofactor set option. Each value of cofactor I set is obviously giving me different QTL peaks but not sure how to choose which model is relevant.
